summary: Tested Master Produk finance extension (current_stock, purchase_price, bom_cost, stock_value). Backend: 7/7 new tests + 62 regression tests PASSED. Frontend: 3 stat cards, 4 new columns, form modal with 3 new fields, and quick-apply BOM cost button all working correctly. Sample scenario verified end-to-end: product with stock=25, purchase_price=15000 → stock_value=Rp 375.000; BOM component (Kertas ArtPaper × 1 @ Rp 2000) → bom_cost=Rp 2.000.

issues: Pre-existing: React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from visual editor wrapper (x-source-path="name") in comp-mat-* selects at line 1860. Unrelated to this feature — cosmetic dev-mode warning only. Consider using data-attribute markers instead of span wrappers, or suppress on <option> elements.

critical_code_review_comments: Inventory.jsx is 1917 lines — approaching split threshold. ProductsTab (~350 lines) could be extracted to its own file for maintainability.

Backend ProductIn does not validate current_stock/purchase_price to be non-negative. Per user, negative is accepted (results in absurd stock_value but no error) — this is an acceptable design choice per spec, but consider Pydantic Field(ge=0) for safety.

Frontend use-bom-cost comparison uses Math.round(bomCost) — for BOM cost with fractional cents (e.g., 2000.50), the button won't hide after applying because it applies Math.round(bomCost)=2001 but comparison is on stored 2000.50. In practice bom_cost is currency (whole IDR), so acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures create/cleanup TEST_PF_* prefixed materials, products, and sales — self-cleanup via zzz_cleanup test.
